task.title: Deleting an image by using the API
task.shortdesc: To remove an image tag from a Red Hat Quay repository, you can use the API.

ul.li: You have Created an OAuth access token.

step.cmd: You can delete an image tag by using the DELETE /api/v1/repository/{repository}/tag/{tag} command:

info.p: This command does not return output in the CLI. Continue on to the next step to return a list of tags.

step.cmd: To see a list of tags after deleting a tag, you can use the GET /api/v1/repository/{repository}/tag/ command. For example:
